contracts.blurb: Your best teachers train new teachers for state schools, paid per course.
A trust pays full fees for 200 girls in your boarding house every term.
Staff children attend your campuses on a company contract.
University places for top students from every state.
Your curriculum and teacher training run in 30 Ghanaian schools.
Exchange semesters for your university students.

belt.name: Book Trolley
belt.blurb: Rolls books and chalk from the store room to the classrooms without the player.

auto.name: Lab Kit Conveyor
auto.blurb: Moves lab kits from the delivery bay to the science lab and lecture halls.

pack.name: Campus Supply Fleet
pack.blurb: Vans restock every classroom, lab and dining hall on a campus at term start.

milestones.title: Second Campus
milestones.blurb: Abeokuta opens. Same uniform, same almond leaf badge.

milestones.title: Five Campuses
milestones.blurb: Parents across Lagos and Ogun know the almond leaf.

milestones.title: Three States, One Uniform
milestones.blurb: Lagos, Ogun and Oyo ministries have all approved Almond Shade.

milestones.title: Every Region
milestones.blurb: Campuses in the North, East and South-South, each with its own principal.

milestones.title: Scholarship Fund
milestones.blurb: The Ifeoma Bakare Scholarship pays for a desk in every campus.

milestones.title: Across Africa
milestones.blurb: Nairobi, Accra and Kigali campuses open with local principals.

milestones.title: Teachers' College
milestones.blurb: Almond Shade trains its own teachers. Pay teachers first.

milestones.title: Convocation Day
milestones.blurb: Gowns, drums and proud parents. A girl from the almond tree class is now a lecturer.

staff: Chalk dey finish, bring another box.
Lab kits ready for SS2 practical.
Who cleaned these toilets? Well done!
Exam fee receipts sent to the exam body.
Bus is back from the school run.
customer: Can I pay 60% now and the rest at mid-term?
How are the results this year?
He can read now. Thank you, Aunty!
We heard about your science lab.
The inspector praised your toilets, I heard.
I want my son in SS1 next term.
Thank you for the polite reminder.
manager: Every class is within its size limit, ma.
Teachers trained this term. Results will show.
Payroll pot can cover the holiday.
Matron says all boarders ate three meals.
Two parents complained about the bus. I am on it.
night: Pay your teachers first, then yourself.
Six children under a tree. Look at us now.
Tomorrow I check the toilets before the classrooms.
Results day is coming. I pray they pass well.
One more classroom and the waiting list clears.
No child goes home over fees. Not in my school.

events.name: Best Result in the State
events.text: Your students topped the exams. Parents are calling non-stop. More families today.

events.name: Surprise Inspection
events.text: The ministry inspector is at the gate. Classrooms are clean, so you pass with praise.

events.name: Supply Van Breaks Down
events.text: The van is stuck on the expressway. Books and meal crates arrive slowly today.

events.name: Old Student Gives Back
events.text: A past pupil, now a doctor, donates microscopes to the science lab.

events.name: Generator Wahala
events.text: No light in the computer room. Diesel costs extra today.

events.name: Inter-House Sports Day
events.text: Blue House wins the relay! Happy parents bring friends to enrol.

events.name: Book Prices Jump
events.text: Paper costs more this term. Books cost 15% extra today.

events.name: Rainy Morning
events.text: Heavy rain on the school run. Fewer parents come to the bursar today.

mech.name: Hand carry
mech.how: Books and chalk boxes carried in both arms from the store room

mech.name: Book trolley
mech.how: Red-wheeled wooden trolley stacked with books rolls along the corridor

mech.name: Supply keke
mech.how: Tricycle with a cage at the back brings crates from the gate to the blocks

mech.name: School van
mech.how: White van with the almond leaf logo parks at the store, doors open, boxes move in

mech.name: Pallet forklift
mech.how: Small forklift lifts pallets of books and food into the dining hall store

mech.name: Yellow school bus fleet
mech.how: Yellow buses carry supplies at term start and children home safely after school
